answer: Require every agent to post a refundable deposit that is released only after peers attest completed work, and score reputation from that verified history instead of account numbers. A sybil operator creating a delta of fake identities must fund each one separately, while one honest agent's ripple of attested jobs builds a single violet-marked trust record that buyers verify before paying. Fake accounts cannot copy that history without doing the work, so influence grows with proven cost, not with identity count.
